checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, in-law or accessory apartment provision
In R-1 no existing single family dwelling may be converted into two or more dwelling units (702.15)

Two-family dwellings are allowed by right in R-2 and R-3 (Section 501). A unit inside the house there may be possible as a conversion to a two-family dwelling, if the lot meets the two-family lot area and width
Two-family lots in R-2 and R-3 need 3,500 sq ft per dwelling unit and 75 ft of width (Section 508). Ask the zoning office how this applies to an existing lot
Permitted residential accessory structures are greenhouses, sheds, private garages or carports, pools and satellite dishes (Section 305). A dwelling is not on the list
A use neither permitted nor denied goes to the Zoning Hearing Board as a special exception (Section 324). Whether a second unit counts as such a use is for the Zoning Officer and the Board
More than one principal structure on a lot also needs land development approval (314.1)
A dwelling unit is for one family. More than four unrelated persons is not a family (Section 203)

term.note: Searched Article 2 definitions, the Article 5 use tables, Article 3 and Article 7 for: accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, elder cottage, ECHO, granny, carriage house, second dwelling, accessory residential. No ADU term.

status.note: The code has no ADU text. R-1 bars converting a single family dwelling into two or more units (702.15). Two-family dwellings are by right in R-2 and R-3.

path.note: Reading: a second unit on a single family lot is not a listed use. In R-1 702.15 bars conversion to 'two or more dwelling units'. The path is a use variance from the Zoning Hearing Board.

fallback_path.note: Same as path. Section 324 sends a use 'neither specifically permitted nor denied' to the Board as a special exception. Applying it to a second unit is not settled by the text.

detached_in_yard_path.note: A detached dwelling is not a listed residential accessory structure (305). Reading: a second dwelling building needs a use variance.

zoning_districts.note: No district lists an ADU. Reading of a silent code. Two-family dwellings: R-2 and R-3 by right.

historic_bypass.note: No ADU text, so no historic path. 703 adds HD Historic Overlay rules.

types_allowed.note: No ADU form is listed. A conversion to a two-family dwelling in R-2 or R-3 is a separate path, not an ADU.

max_height_ft.note: Unattached accessory structures in R zones: 'one and one-half (1 1/2) stories or fifteen (15) feet, whichever is the lesser.'

setback_front_ft.note: Unattached accessory structures in any R zone 'shall be erected only within the rear or side yard'. Not in the front yard.

setback_side_ft.note: 'not less than five (5) feet from either side lot line'. Corner lots follow Section 304.

setback_rear_ft.note: 'not less than five (5) feet from the rear lot line'.

setback_rear_alley_ft.note: 'when the accessory structure abuts an alley, ten (10) feet shall be required.'

separation_ft.note: No separation between buildings on the same lot found in Section 302.

max_building_coverage.note: Varies by district: R-1 40%, R-2 50%, R-3 60%. See districts.

family_only.note: No ADU rule. A dwelling unit is for one family. A group over four unrelated persons is not a family.

max_adus.note: Reading: no ADU is allowed by right.

spaces_required.note: No ADU row. Single-family detached and two-family: 'Two (2) spaces for each dwelling unit.'
